name: @acme-skunkworks/agent-skills
description: Shared agent skills (Claude Code, Cursor) distributed as skills.sh-compatible bundles.

scripts.lint:sh: bash -c 'if command -v shellcheck >/dev/null 2>&1; then shellcheck scripts/*.sh infrastructure/scripts/*.sh; elif [ "$(uname -s)" = "Darwin" ]; then echo "⚠️  shellcheck not installed — skipping. Install: brew install shellcheck"; else echo "⚠️  shellcheck not installed — skipping. Install: apt-get install shellcheck"; fi'
scripts.test:sh: bash -c 'if command -v bats >/dev/null 2>&1; then bats infrastructure/tests/*.bats; elif [ "$(uname -s)" = "Darwin" ]; then echo "⚠️  bats not installed — skipping. Install: brew install bats-core"; else echo "⚠️  bats not installed — skipping. Install: apt-get install bats"; fi'
